Subject: Post-demo: security & compliance follow-up + pen test report request

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Per our call, I wanted to summarize the outstanding security/compliance items you asked about and propose next steps so your procurement/security teams have what they need to continue evaluation.

Summary of asks from FinTechCo:
- SOC 2 status and whether a Type II report is available or when it will be.
- GDPR/HIPAA posture — data residency, PHI handling (if applicable).
- Pen test report availability and vulnerability management process (cadence, SLA for remediation, disclosure policy).
- Next steps for procurement (contracting timeline, any required NDAs to exchange redacted reports).

What we can share today:
- Attached: short SOC 2 summary (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf) and an anonymized pen-test summary (redwood_pen_test_summary.pdf) that covers scope and high-level findings. Full pen-test reports often require an NDA; happy to follow whatever process you prefer.

Action items / proposed next steps:
1) Tom / Alice: confirm if you need a fully redacted pen-test report or the high-level summary is sufficient for initial review.
2) If you need the full report, we can route a DocuSign NDA or coordinate an SSO-protected report drop. Please confirm the contact for legal/procurement to complete an NDA.
3) Rishi / Neha: can you confirm the pen-test cadence, vulnerability SLA, and disclosure policy so I can include details for FinTechCo?
4) Marissa: follow up with procurement (Alice) to align on contract timeline and next call.

Attachments referenced: fintechco_pen_test_request.pdf (their original questionnaire) — I attached it for clarity.

Thanks — feel free to flag anything missing. Happy to jump on a quick follow-up call this week.

Best,

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) For initial procurement review, the SOC 2 summary and the anonymized pen-test summary will do — but our security team will likely request the full pen-test report before signing.
2) We specifically need details on scanning cadence (how frequently you run automated scans), how often external third-party pen tests occur, and your SLA for triaging/patching critical/high vulnerabilities.
3) On GDPR/HIPAA: we handle EU customers and have PHI flows in a subset of our product. Can you confirm whether Redwood has a HIPAA BA (or supports BA agreements) and whether you offer EU data residency for Private deployments?

Alice from procurement — looping you in to confirm NDA preference and the right contact for legal.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security & compliance follow-up + pen test report request

Hi all — quick answers to the items Tom called out. I'll keep this high-level here; we can share more detail once an NDA is in place.

SOC 2:
- Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II readiness; most controls are in production and we completed our last Type II audit in Q4 2025. The formal Type II report is available to customers under an NDA. The attached "redwood_soc2_summary.pdf" outlines scope and relevant controls for hosted/private deployments.

Pen tests and scanning cadence:
- External third-party pen tests: performed annually by a CREST-accredited firm (scope includes API endpoints, admin console, and networking perimeter for hosted clusters). We can provide a redacted report that omits customer-identifying data upon request.
- Continuous scanning: we run authenticated SAST and scheduled DAST scans against staging every 2 weeks; CI-integrated SAST runs on every PR.
- Container/image scanning: weekly automated scans for known CVEs.

Vulnerability management & SLAs:
- Triage: confirmed within 48 business hours of validated report.
- Severity classification: Critical / High / Medium / Low (standard CVSS mapping).
- Fix SLA targets: Critical — 7 calendar days (hotfix or mitigations deployed); High — 30 calendar days; Medium/low — prioritized in roadmap/multiple-release windows.
- Disclosure policy: coordinated vulnerability disclosure; we notify impacted customers and provide mitigations before public disclosure. We can share our CVD process doc under NDA or via a secure portal.

GDPR / HIPAA / Data residency:
- GDPR: we support data processing terms and SCCs for EU customers; our privacy team can provide the DPA.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA workloads on Private deployments and offers BAAs for qualifying customers. For hosted customers that require HIPAA, we evaluate on a case-by-case basis and typically recommend Private deployment with our enterprise package.

Next steps:
- Marissa: if FinTechCo confirms NDA route, legal can run DocuSign and we'll circulate the full SOC2 report + redacted pen-test report via secure link.
- If helpful, I can join a short call with your security team to walk through cadence and SLAs.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (summary), redwood_pen_test_summary.pdf (anonymized).

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
